just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on D5 and dwells most on D in Hejaz. The line peaks at D5 (557.7 Hz) at 0:03.7. It closes on D5, not the tonic (G4 → C3 → D5 → D5 → D5 → D5).
